snippet.title: So, I Made a New Horror Game... | MATILDA
snippet.description:
So... I made a new horror game.

In MATILDA, you play as a 5-year-old boy left home alone with his older sister while your parents are away.

Everything seems normal at first.

Then your sister makes a mistake.

This video is a quick message from the developer about the game, its development, and the possibility of future chapters.

🎮 Play MATILDA:
https://redcap-games.itch.io/matilda

If you enjoyed the game and would like to see Chapter 2 happen sooner, consider supporting the project on itch.io.

Thank you for playing ❤️

#indiegame #horrorgame #matilda #gamedev #indiehorror
